uṇakumbha: [Uṇha+kumbha] (pu) CL=7 A hot pot or the pot is hot.
uṇha: [(1)usa+ṇhā] (ti) CL=7 [Nīti,dhā.258. Nīti,sutta.931.(2)usa+ṇha. Dhāna,ṭī.80.(3)usa+na. Vi,pi,dhāna.] (1) Hot. (Pu) (2) A period of being hot. Summer. (Na) (3) Heat.
uṇhabahula: [Uṇha+bahula] (ti) CL=7 It has a lot of heat. Very hot.
uṇhabharita: [Uṇha+bharita] (ti) CL=7 Filled with heat. See - Uṇhaviriya.
uṇhabhaya: [Uṇha+bhaya] (na) CL=7 Fear of heat. The danger of heat.
uṇhabhāva: [Uṇha+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As a hot state. Heat.
uṇhabhāvasiddha: [Uṇhabhāva+siddha] (ti) CL=7 That happened due to heat.
uṇhabhāvavisiṭṭha: [Uṇhabhāva+visiṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 Distinguished by a hot state.
uṇhabhāvāvigamanattha: [Uṇhabhāva+avigamanattha] (pu) CL=7 The result of releasing heat.
uṇhacitta: [Uṇha+citta] (ti) CL=7 One who has a weary mind.
uṇhagahāpanageha: [Uṇha+gahāpana+geha] (na) CL=7 A house that receives heat or worry.
uṇhakalāpa: [Uṇha+kalāpa] (pu) CL=7 A group of elementary particles that has excessive heat.
uṇhakaraṇavalāhaka: [Uṇha+karaṇa+valāhaka] (pu) CL=7 A cloud that causes heat.
uṇhakāla: [Uṇha+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of hot season.
uṇhapakatika: [Uṇha+pakati+ka] (ti) CL=7 The original nature that is hot. Very hot.
uṇhappavesana: [Uṇha+pavesana] (na) CL=7 Going into hot. See - uṇhappavesanattha.
uṇhappavesanattha: [Uṇhappavesana+attha] (pu) CL=7 The benefit of going into hot.
uṇhapāyāsa: [Uṇha+pāyāsa] (pu) CL=7 The hot milk rice porridge.
uṇhasamaya: [Uṇha+samaya] (pu) CL=7 Time of heat or a period of hot season.
uṇhasamphuṭṭha: [Uṇha+samphuṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 Touched by heat. Afflicted by heat.
uṇhasantāpa: [Uṇha+santāpa] (pu) CL=7 Burning with heat. The intensity of heat.
uṇhatta: [Uṇha+tta] (na) CL=7 As a state of hot. Heating.
uṇhattalakkhaṇa: [Uṇhatta+lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1)The sign of radiated heat. (Ti) (2) Has the sign of radiated heat.
uṇhautu: [Uṇha+utu] (pu,thī) CL=7 The radiated heat. Hot season. See also - Uṇhavalāhaka, pabbatautu.
uṇhautusamuṭṭhāna: [Uṇhautu+samuṭṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 Has the origin or cause that is radiated heat. Arises due to radiated heat.
uṇhavalāhaka: [Uṇha+valāhaka] (pu) CL=7 The warm cloud. See - Uṇhavalāhaka-(2).  uṇhavalāhaka(ti) [uṇhavalāhaka+a] Deva who causes the warm cloud or warm weather.
uṇhavalāhakadevatā: [Uṇhavalāhaka+devatā] (thī) CL=7 The cause of the warm cloud that is a Deva. Uṇhavalāhaka Deva.
uṇhavalāhakantara: [Uṇhavalāhaka+antara] (na) CL=7 Inside of the warm cloud. See - Uṇhautusamuṭṭhāna.
uṇhavelā: [Uṇha+velā] (thī) CL=7 The time of when it is hot or a period of hot season.
uṇhaviriya: [Uṇha+viriya] (ti) CL=7 The hot power or energy.
uṇhavālikānippīḷita: [Uṇhā+vālikā+nippīḷita] (ti) CL=7 Afflicted by the hot sand.
uṇhavālukāpiṭṭha: [Uṇhavālukā+piṭṭha] (na) CL=7 The surface of the hot sand.
uṇhaṭṭha: [Uṇha+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of hot or the meaning of worry.
uṇhodaka: [Uṇha+udaka] (na) CL=7 (1) Warm water. Hot water. (Ti) (2) Has the hot water.
uṇhodakavaṇṇa: [Uṇhodaka+vaṇṇa] (pu) CL=7 The appearance of warm water.
uṇhābhitatta: [Uṇha+abhitatta] (ti) CL=7 Scorched and distressed by heat.
uṇhādinimitta: [Uṇha+ādi+nimitta] (na) CL=7 A cause that is heat, etc.,
uṇhādipīḷita: [Uṇha+ādi+pīḷita] (ti) CL=7 Afflicted or tormented with heat, etc.,
uṇhādirasa: [Uṇha+ādi+rasa] (pu) CL=7 The taste of hot, etc.,
uṇhākāra: [Uṇha+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 (1) The state of hot. (Ti) Has the state of hot.
uṇhāpetvā: [Usa+ṇhā+ṇape+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having caused it to be hot.
uṇhīsa: [U+naha+īsa] (pu,na) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.284.uṇha+īsa.vi,pi,dhāna.] (1) (A) Forehead of Lord Buddha. Head wrap. Turban. (B) The relic of the forehead of Lord Buddha. This is Uṇhīsa Dhātu in seven Asambhinna Dhātu. (2) The top of the covered passage (at the pagoda). See also - Uṇhīsapaṭṭa, uṇhīsasīsa. Uṇhīsa(na) [uṇhīsa+a]. A well-filled-out forehead that is like a turban. (B) The well-filled-out head that is like a turban.
uṇhīsamatthaka: [Uṇhīsa+matthaka] (na) CL=7 The peak or summit. Above the top. The top of the covered passage (at the pagoda).
uṇhīsapaṭṭa: [Uṇhīsa+paṭṭa] (pu) CL=7 The head wrap (the flat substance).
uṇhīsasīsa: [Uṇhīsa+veṭhika+sīsa] (ti) CL=7 [Uṇhīsa+sīsa] (1) (Has a well-filled-out forehead) that is like the head decorated with a turban. (2) The circular shape head (means a well-filled-out head) that is like a turban.
uṇhīsaveṭhitasīsa: [Uṇhīsa+veṭhita+sīsa] (ti) CL=7 The head is wrapped with a turban. See also - Uṇhīsasīsa.
uṇṇa: [Ūṇu+a.(ūṇa-saṃ)] (na) CL=7 Fur. wool. See - Uṇṇapāvāraṇa, uṇṇamaya. In Āḷi, aṭṭhakathā, it is Uṇṇā- as itthiliṅga. See also - Uṇṇā.
uṇṇabhisi: [Uṇṇā+bhisi] (thī) CL=7 The mattress that is filled with feathers (such as wool or feathers of the bird). A woot mattress.
uṇṇaja: [¿] (ti) CL=7 That is well-filled-out which is like a mirror decorated with gold.
uṇṇaloma: [Uṇṇā+loma] (na) CL=7 (1) Hair. Wool. (2) A hair that grows between the two eyebrows of Lord Buddha which hair is called Uṇṇā. That is noble hair. A single hair which grows between Buddha"s eyebrows. See also - Uṇṇā.
uṇṇamati: [U+nama+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 He becomes arrogant. See also - Uṇṇamati.
uṇṇanābhi: [Uṇṇā+nābhi.(ūṇīnābhi-saṃ)] (pu) CL=7 The spider has hair at his navel.
uṇṇanābhisutta: [Uṇṇanābhi+sutta] (na) CL=7 The spider"s hair or fur.
uṇṇapāvāra: [Uṇṇā+pāvāra] (pu) CL=7 The covering garment or outer garment that is made of wool. See - Uṇṇī.
uṇṇapāvāraṇa: [Uṇṇā+pāvāraṇa] (na) CL=7 The outer garment that is made of wool.
uṇṇata: [U+nama+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Elevated. Raised. (2) Become arrogant. Proud. (3) Noble. (4) Wandering mind. (5) The head wrap ornament. See also - Uṇṇatuṇṇata, uṇṇatoṇata. See also - Anunnata.
uṇṇati: [U+nama+ti] (thī) CL=7 Pride. Arrogance. See also - Unnati.
uṇṇatilakkhaṇa: [Uṇṇa(nna)ti+lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 (Māna) that has the sign of pride.
uṇṇatoṇata: [Uṇṇata+oṇata] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is high now and low later. One who is going from the higher realm to the lower realm. (2) Has a higher state and lower state. See - Uṇṇatoṇataṭṭhānayutta.
uṇṇatoṇataṭṭhānayutta: [Uṇṇatoṇata+ṭhāna+yutta] (ti) CL=7 Yoked with a higher place and a lower place.
uṇṇatuṇṇata: [Uṇṇata+uṇṇata] (ti) CL=7 One who is high now and high later. One who is being in the high realm and the next existence is also in the high realm.
uṇṇaṃsu: [Uṇṇa+aṃsu] (pu) CL=7 A hair or fur. See - Jātiuṇṇaṃsu.
uṇṇi: [U+nama+i] (thī) CL=7 A boil that is swollen up. See - Uṇṇigaṇḍa.
uṇṇigaṇḍa: [Uṇṇi+gaṇḍa] (pu) CL=7 The wart that is a swollen boil.
uṇṇika: [Uṇṇī+ka] (ti) CL=7 Has fur. (A pillow) which is filled with fur.
uṇṇā: [Ūṇu+a.(ūṇī-saṃ)] (thī) CL=7 (1) Fur (of sheep, etc.). Fur. Wool. (2) A hair that grows between the eyebrows of Lord Buddha. The noble hair. A single hair which grows between Buddha"s eyebrows.
uṇṇābha: [Yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 A Brahmin is named Uṇṇābha.
uṇṇābhisi: [Uṇṇā+bhisi] (thī) CL=7 A mattress that is filled with furs (the feather of birds). A mattress filled with furs. The furs mattress.
uṇṇāloma: [Uṇṇā+loma] (na) CL=7 (1) Fur. Wool. (2) A single hair that grows between the eyebrows of Lord Buddha that is called Uṇṇā. The noble hair. Uṇṇaluṃ hair. See also - Uṇṇā. Uṇṇāloma(na) [uṇṇā+loma]. Same meaning as uṇṇaloma.
uṇṇāmaya: [Uṇṇa(ṇṇā)+maya] (ti) CL=7 Finished with fur. Uṇṇāmaya(ti) [uṇṇā+maya] Same meaning as Uṇṇamaya.
uṇṇāmayaattharaṇa: [Uṇṇāmaya+attharaṇa] (na) CL=7 The flooring sheet that is made of wool.
uṇṇāmayakambala: [Uṇṇāmaya+kambala] (pu,na) CL=7 A blanket made of wool.
uṇṇāmayasutta: [Uṇṇāmaya+sutta] (na) CL=7 Thread or cotton that is made of wool. A woolen thread.
uṇṇāmayattharaka: [Uṇṇāmaya+attharaka] (pu) CL=7 A blanket made of wool. A woolen blanket.
uṇṇāyu: [Uṇṇā+yu(ūṇīyu.saṃ)] (pu) CL=7 Sheep. (In the Sakkata dictionary, Ūṇīyu-word (1) Sheep. (2) Woolen rug. Woolen cloth. (3) Spider).
uṇṇī: [Uṇṇa+ī] (thī) CL=7 Woolen outer robe or cloak or woolen outer garment.
uṇṇasu: [Uṇṇa+aṃsu] (pu) CL=7 A hair or fur. See - Jātiuṇṇaṃsu.
